the general information about this story.Please answer these three questions according to your understanding of the text.First of all, who are the main characters in the text?Very good.The main timeline to show the development of the story.On the first day, Mrs.Peabody gave the class a writing assignment on summer vacation.What was Jim's feeling about the assignment?The next morning, Jim handed in his writing.How did Jim feel after handing in his writing?The following day, Mrs.Peabody started to comment on the graded essays.What was Jim's feeling then?Shortly after, Mrs.Peabody praised Jim for his courage and imagination.How did Jim feel after hearing this?Now, let's read the story again carefully and find out Jim's feelings.Please complete the table with Jim's feelings based on evidence, especially Jim's behavior from the text.Let me set an example for you.At the beginning of the story, Mrs.Peabody asked the students to write something related to summer vacation and told them to be as creative as they could.What happened next?Did Jim start writing right after school?Actually, no.That night, Jim sat at his desk at home and stared at a blank sheet of paper.Here, the word stare means to look at somebody or something for a long time.The phrase, a blank sheet of paper, is a piece of paper for writing but with nothing written on it.Obviously, he didn't want to text.Share with us what you've got after three minutes.Jim's feelings Jim's feelings Jim's feelings Jim's feelings Jim's feelings Jim's feelings Jim's feelings Jim's feelings Jim's
